q1_issues.issue: 'chalky residue' is fused into the compound kind chalky_residue, but 'chalky' is a descriptive/texture adjective — none of the licensed fusion cases (term of art, nationality/origin, role title, material adjective) — so Compound concepts calls for two atoms ('residue' plus the property 'chalky') the way 'a dented pail' does, not a fused symbol with a modifier genus.

notes: The change-of-kind resultative is exactly the prescribed 'turned into a museum' shape — subject as Patient of the turn event, result state reified with the same subject as Experiencer, the flat copular atom, and the Result link, with no separate entity minted for what it became — and the demonstrative 'that salt-bloom' correctly resolves to the premise variable. 'at the full moon' as a bare named-time symbol on Time, and the capitalized common noun 'Keeper' as plain kind 'keeper' with no Name atom, are both right.
